summary: onSave becomes async and writes a JSON snapshot of the in-memory store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: The change makes onSave return a Promise instead of a string. The router's dispatch returns that Promise, and the server in src/main.js:9 passes it straight to res.end.
findings.consequence: res.end throws a type error on a Promise argument, so every POST /save request crashes the server process. The rejected writeFile promise also floats with no handler.
findings.fix: Make dispatch and the request handler await the result before calling res.end, and handle a rejection with an error response.

findings.title: New snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a file write and an async return to onSave. No test in the repository exercises onSave or the snapshot file.
findings.consequence: A regression in the save path or the snapshot format would reach users unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls onSave, awaits it, and checks the returned text and the written snapshot.
